description:
Cast Dross Scorpion for {4}.
With Dross Scorpion on the stack, use Lithoform Engine to copy the spell, using Chromatic Orrery to pay for Lithoform Engine.
Let the copy of Dross Scorpion resolve.
Sacrifice Dross Scorpion to Goblin Bombardment, Dealing 1 damage to any target.
Dross Scorpion triggers twice due to Teysa Karlov.
untap Lithoform Engine and Chromatic Orrery with the Dross Scorpion triggers.
Repeat steps 2-6.
